_meta.source: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Service Level Agreements
_meta.measurement: Monthly Uptime Percentage (MUP) — measured per calendar month
_meta.credit_structure: Standard: <99.9% = 10% credit; <99.0% = 25% credit; <95.0% = 100% credit (service-specific tiers vary)
_meta.note: Always verify against current Oracle Pillar Document at oracle.com/contracts. SLAs apply to data plane (service availability) unless noted. Control plane SLAs may differ.

services.service: Compute — Virtual Machine (VM) and Bare Metal (BM)
services.notes: Financially-backed 99.99% monthly uptime for both VM and BM instances. Applies to the ability to start, stop, and access running instances. Does not guarantee application-level availability — customer responsible for multi-AD deployment for HA.
services.multi_ad_note: Single instance SLA is 99.99%; for zero-downtime, deploy across multiple ADs or use instance pools with health checks.

services.service: Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE) — Enhanced Clusters
services.notes: Enhanced Clusters carry a financially-backed SLA covering Kubernetes API server uptime. Basic Clusters have a service-level objective (SLO) only — no financial SLA. Worker node availability follows Compute SLA.
services.multi_ad_note: Enhanced Cluster control plane SLA is 99.95%. Deploy worker node pools across multiple ADs for full HA.

services.service: Container Engine for Kubernetes (OKE) — Basic Clusters
services.notes: Basic Clusters provide a service-level objective (SLO) but NOT a financially-backed SLA. Recommend Enhanced Clusters for FedRAMP/regulated workloads.
services.multi_ad_note: No financial SLA; use Enhanced Clusters for compliance-sensitive workloads.

services.notes: 99.95% availability SLA (maximum ~22 minutes downtime per month) without Autonomous Data Guard. Includes automatic patching, tuning, and failover within a single AD.
services.multi_ad_note: Single-AD deployment. Enable Autonomous Data Guard for cross-AD/cross-region failover and 99.995% SLA.

services.service: Autonomous Database Serverless (ADB-S) — with Autonomous Data Guard
services.notes: 99.995% availability SLA when Autonomous Data Guard standby is enabled. Provides automatic failover to a standby in a different AD or region. This is the highest ADB SLA tier.
services.multi_ad_note: Cross-AD standby required. Highly recommended for production FedRAMP workloads.

services.service: Autonomous Database on Dedicated Exadata Infrastructure
services.notes: 99.995% availability SLA on dedicated Exadata. Includes Data Guard protection. Exadata infrastructure itself has additional availability SLAs.
services.multi_ad_note: Dedicated infrastructure with cross-AD Data Guard delivers the highest Oracle DB availability commitment.

services.service: Base Database Service (DB System — Single Node)
services.notes: Single-node DB systems follow standard 99.95% availability SLA. Maintenance windows apply. No automatic failover — customer manages Data Guard manually.
services.multi_ad_note: Deploy a 2-node RAC or manual Data Guard standby in a second AD for HA beyond the base SLA.

services.service: Base Database Service (DB System — 2-Node RAC / Data Guard)
services.notes: 2-node RAC on Exadata DB Systems or manual Data Guard with a standby in another AD qualifies for higher availability SLA commitments per the Oracle Pillar Document.
services.multi_ad_note: Requires deployment across two ADs. Manual configuration; not automatically managed like ADB.

services.notes: OCI Flexible Load Balancer provides 99.99% monthly uptime SLA. The service is regional and spans multiple ADs. Includes both Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and Layer 4 (TCP) capabilities.
services.multi_ad_note: Load Balancer is a regional service — Oracle manages multi-AD redundancy transparently. No additional customer action required for SLA.

services.notes: Network Load Balancer (Layer 4, ultra-low latency) provides 99.99% monthly uptime SLA. Regional service with multi-AD redundancy managed by Oracle.
services.multi_ad_note: Regional service; Oracle-managed HA.

services.notes: 99.9% availability SLA. Data durability is designed at 99.999999999% (11 nines) via redundant storage across multiple storage servers and ADs within a region. SLA covers access to stored data.
services.multi_ad_note: Regional service — data replicated across ADs automatically. Durability SLA separate from availability SLA.

services.notes: 99.99% availability SLA for block volume data plane access. Annual durability designed at 99.99% (4 nines). Includes both boot volumes and data volumes. Volume backup/replication recommended for disaster recovery beyond the SLA.
services.multi_ad_note: Block Volumes are AD-scoped; cross-AD replication or Volume Group Backups recommended for DR.

services.notes: 99.9% availability SLA for NFS file system access. AD-scoped service; cross-AD replication is manual.
services.multi_ad_note: AD-scoped; implement cross-region or cross-AD replication for HA beyond the SLA.

services.service: Virtual Cloud Network (VCN) and Core Networking
services.notes: Core OCI networking components (VCN, Subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, Route Tables, Internet Gateway, NAT Gateway, Service Gateway) carry 99.99% availability SLA. VCN is a regional construct spanning all ADs.
services.multi_ad_note: VCN is regional. Subnets are AD-specific; design for multi-AD subnet coverage to match workload HA requirements.

services.notes: 99.9% availability SLA for a single FastConnect virtual circuit. For redundant configurations (two circuits across different FastConnect locations or providers), Oracle recommends achieving 99.99% effective availability through redundant design, though the per-circuit SLA remains 99.9%.
services.multi_ad_note: Implement two redundant FastConnect circuits across different providers/locations for 99.99% effective connectivity.

services.notes: 99.9% availability SLA for OCI WAF policy enforcement. WAF is a regional service. Includes both Edge WAF (global PoPs) and regional WAF integrated with Load Balancer.
services.multi_ad_note: Regional service with Oracle-managed redundancy.

services.notes: 99.9% financially-backed SLA; 99.99% service-level objective (SLO). Oracle uses a cluster of HSM nodes and replicates key material within the region. SLA credit tiers: <99.9% = 10% credit; <99.0% = 25% credit; <95.0% = 100% credit.
services.multi_ad_note: Vault is regional with cross-AD replication of HSM clusters. Dedicated KMS (HSM-dedicated) available for higher isolation requirements.

services.notes: Dedicated HSM partition for single-tenant key management (FIPS 140-2 Level 3). Same 99.9% SLA as shared Vault. Provides exclusive HSM access for compliance requirements mandating dedicated cryptographic hardware.
services.multi_ad_note: Single HSM partition per vault; plan for cross-region replication of encrypted resources for DR.

services.notes: Managed bastion service for secure SSH/RDP access without public IPs. 99.9% availability SLA. Sessions have a maximum TTL configurable up to 3 hours.
services.multi_ad_note: Regional service; deploy per-AD if AD-level isolation is required.

services.service: OCI Kubernetes Engine (OKE) — Node Pools (Worker Nodes)
services.notes: Worker node availability follows the OCI Compute SLA (99.99%). OKE manages node health checks and replacement within node pools.
services.multi_ad_note: Spread node pool across multiple ADs for worker node HA.

SLO_only: OKE Basic Cluster (99.95% SLO, no SLA)

architecture_guidance.multi_ad_design: Deploying across 3 ADs in a multi-AD region (e.g., us-ashburn-1, ap-tokyo-1) provides resilience beyond any single-service SLA. Many services (Load Balancer, VCN, Object Storage) are already regional.
architecture_guidance.single_ad_regions: OCI single-AD regions (e.g., us-chicago-1) do not provide cross-AD failover. Use cross-region replication for DR in single-AD regions.
architecture_guidance.highest_db_availability: For highest database availability: use ADB-S + Autonomous Data Guard (99.995% SLA) or ADB on Dedicated Exadata.
architecture_guidance.networking_redundancy: For FastConnect HA: deploy 2+ circuits across different providers/locations. IPsec VPN as backup has no SLA.
architecture_guidance.encryption_compliance: For FedRAMP: use OCI Vault with CMK for all regulated data; Dedicated KMS for FIPS 140-2 Level 3 mandate.
